title: Short-term Insurance Act 53 of 1998
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Short-term Insurance Act 53 of 1998'. Commencement: 1 January 1999. Amended by Insurance Act 18 of 2017 and Financial Sector Regulation Act 9 of 2017. It is amended, not repealed.
notes: Kept for conduct of business and policyholder protection. The Policyholder Protection Rules made under it govern claims handling. Long-term Insurance Act 52 of 1998 is the life-insurance counterpart; it is on gov.za at /documents/long-term-insurance-act but was not separately detailed here.
